title: Intent
description: Intent layer (spec-v1.0: 'Desired action'). A recorded request. An Intent is an observation target, not a fact: recording an Intent asserts only that the request was received, not that it was carried out or succeeded.

id.description: Identifier of this Intent, unique within the record stream.

action.description: Name of the requested action, as submitted.

target.description: What the requested action is directed at, as submitted.

parameters.description: Request parameters, as submitted. Recorded verbatim; the runtime does not interpret them.
